name: atlanai-analytics
description: Try Atlan Analytics on a demo or set it up on your own data, step by step: survey dashboards and query history, generate and check metrics, save them locally or to Atlan, ask questions and build a dashboard.

interface.shortDescription: Publish analytics context and ask your data with Atlan
interface.longDescription: The analytics workload on the Atlan registry, as five skills. analytics-demo walks through a made-up firm end to end. analytics-build does the same on your own data, starting from nothing, a dashboard or a subject: it surveys what you already have, asks what you want to answer, and builds from reports first, then query history, then table definitions. source-survey says what a setup, a subject or a source holds, what can be built from it, and which metric names it offers. metrics-generation generates, checks, edits, proposes and publishes metrics and saved queries with the metrics engine. analytics-ask answers a data question from published metrics, with the definition it used, and turns answers into a dashboard. It finds your Snowflake, Databricks or other warehouse through Atlan or your own connector, and uses the Atlan plugin's connection.
defaultPrompt: Show me an Atlan Analytics demo
Help me use this dashboard, folder or BI export to ask questions about my data
Build metrics and saved queries for our support tables from the warehouse's query history
